primary.name: Daily Global Markets Digest
guidance: Publish a short report every day, even when there is no major market-moving development.
On quiet days, keep the report concise and explain the current market focus instead of forcing weak stories.
Cover crypto, US equities, global macro, Europe, Turkey, rates, regulation, earnings, and major risk events only when they materially affect market context.

audience: Global piyasa, crypto, ABD teknoloji hisseleri, Nasdaq ve S&P 500 takip eden bireysel yatırımcılar
Türkiye, Avrupa ve ABD makro gelişmelerini tek Türkçe özetle görmek isteyen power user'lar
Haber akışını yatırım tavsiyesi değil, doğrulanmış piyasa bağlamı olarak tüketmek isteyen okuyucular

officialOrReferenceTargets: Federal Reserve, ECB, TCMB, BLS, SEC, Treasury, Borsa Istanbul, KAP, SPK, official issuer or exchange notices
Use market data tools or reputable quote pages for price and index sanity checks when discussing moves.
Do not present price targets, trade calls, or portfolio advice.

rankBy: direct market-moving impact across crypto, US equities, Europe, Turkey, rates, FX, or commodities
primary-source confirmation from a central bank, regulator, exchange, company, ETF issuer, or statistics agency
breadth of affected assets or investor attention
change in market regime, liquidity, yields, risk appetite, volatility, or policy expectations
clear relevance to Bitcoin, Ethereum, major altcoins, Nasdaq, S&P 500, mega-cap technology, Turkey, or Europe
practical watchlist value for the next trading session or major calendar event
rejectIf: source link is missing or circular
claim is only social-media speculation, influencer commentary, or a single unverified rumor
story is a routine price move without a verified catalyst or useful context
altcoin story is mainly pump, promotion, token listing noise, or price-target content
same story was already covered in recent automation memory without a material update
item reads as investment advice, trade recommendation, or guaranteed forecast
